findings.message: `Db2Hook` already names both of these values - `conn_type = "ibmdb2"` and `default_conn_name = "db2_default"` - and this fixture (and `mock_connection_with_extras` at line 52) restates them as literals instead. The restatement has already drifted: the connection is built with `conn_type="db2"`, which is not the type the hook registers in provider.yaml. Build the fixture `Connection` from `Db2Hook.conn_type` and `Db2Hook.default_conn_name` so the fixtures cannot disagree with the hook.

This `if extra:` branch in `get_uri()` is added here and no test takes it: all three `get_uri` tests use connections without an `extra`, so the uppercased keys, the `urlencode` query string and the bool -> "true"/"false" conversion at line 139 are never exercised - only the plain `return base_uri` side is. Add a `get_uri` case on `mock_connection_with_extras` asserting the `?SECURITY=SSL&SSLSERVERCERTIFICATE=...` suffix, plus one with a boolean extra value.
